Original running cohort plus the two observed release-step admissions, minus completed requests, yields exactly the decoder output ID sets plus this one still-prefilling long request. Every decoder emits one token. No preemptions/new admissions intervene. Deterministic pinned running-loop arithmetic gives780/780/782/782/118. post_ack_wait_diagnosis.legality_boundary: This is exhausted compute token budget ahead of waiting, not a ready unsubmitted LOAD/STORE queue. Both LOADs are ACKed already. No legal transfer-only reorder or earlier ACK consumption is shown to open the four zero-budget loops. Serving target earlier would require reallocating compute budget or changing running-versus-waiting execution order; present traces do not establish its admissibility under fixed service/priority constraints or its benefit.
post_ack_wait_diagnosis.uncertainty: The per-call token_budget and queue head were not directly logged. Rows explicitly distinguish source-constrained reconstruction from observed output/counter fields; no GPU completion clock or counterfactual request benefit is inferred.

bounded_source_entry_feasibility.insertion: Inside the original waiting loop immediately before its allocate_slots call (~scheduler935), after the existing native lookup/token calculation and before allocation/pop/update_state_after_alloc for the current head.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.current_head: Qualified PREEMPTED recovery with computed/held0, native load_kv_async=False, external computed0 and positive scheduled recompute tokens; no APC/encoder/spec/lease/protection. Preserve original full-fit condition; act only when a side-effect-free exact/conservative fit check passes.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.earlier_load_objects: Read local step_skipped_waiting, including this iteration's earlier native WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS requests, together with any public skipped state. Do not rely only on public self.skipped_waiting. Confirm matching req_status.req identity and transfer_jobs whose cs._jobs entries have matching req_id and is_store=False; current-batch jobs are already in cs._current_batch_load_jobs before build_connector_meta.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.provenance: Original scheduler pops the earlier async request, marks WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS and places it in the local skipped queue (978–998). Offloading update_state_after_alloc has already prepare_load/register job+refs (offloading scheduler851–873). These are present-state objects, not future predictions or extra lookups.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.action: A one-shot callback may return break without popping/reordering current head. The existing post-loop skipped merge and metadata build still run, and all earlier STORE/LOAD jobs submit/complete through unchanged native paths. Already-scheduled running compute is retained. Never wait synchronously for completion inside schedule.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.scope: The break defers the remaining waiting suffix as well as the current recompute. It can preserve queue order, existing running priority/quantum/victim and native ownership, but cannot claim unchanged later admission times.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.dependency_semantics: Earlier request next-output depends on its own LOAD. The later request has no native cross-request correctness dependency on that LOAD; choosing to wait is an additional scheduling precedence, not discovery of a hard edge.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.simple_baseline: At this natural point the earlier LOADs were ACKed by the end of the same engine call. One fixed one-round break could therefore be behaviorally identical to dependency-conditioned waiting. Any future comparison must retain that equivalence rather than claim benefit or novelty for dependency information.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.limitation: This establishes an insertion point and an observed case, not a tested implementation or request-level benefit. Waiting until ACK beyond one round needs an explicit bounded lifecycle; it is not implemented here.
bounded_source_entry_feasibility.callback_inputs: Must receive actual request_queue/current request, token_budget/preempted locals, step_skipped_waiting, native load_kv_async and num_external_computed_tokens/num_new_tokens. Current request requires external=0, load_kv_async=False, held0 and no own transfer jobs; never defer/cancel a current request whose LOAD ownership has already been prepared. Earlier requests' prepared LOAD refs and registered jobs are observed only and remain untouched.
